rules.cohort: Kvasir Val, source checkpoint-selection/development cohort only; no PolypGen or new datasets
rules.same_gt_primary: selected100; IoU>=.5 compatible with exactly one GT; no assignment of ambiguous boxes
rules.inversions: higher-IoU candidate scores strictly lower; report pair-micro and GT-macro denominators and score ties
rules.sensitivity: IoU>=.25 unique-GT ownership, fixed in advance; descriptive only
rules.coverage: threshold-constrained maximum-cardinality one-to-one matching; all300 vs selected100 vs top1/10
rules.same_gt_permutation: exchange original fused score multiset only within unique-GT IoU>=.5 groups; other scores unchanged
rules.image_gt_permutation: exchange image's original fused score multiset in max-GT-IoU order; quality ties retain native score order; negative images unchanged
rules.direct_gt_iou: all selected100 boxes retained; score=maxIoU or 0 on negatives; GT-assisted reference, not an optimal AP bound
rules.duplicates: official greedy COCO matching, classify unmatched predictions; report top1/10/100 without confidence cut
rules.evaluation: official COCOeval bbox; maxDets=[1,10,100], no filtering/NMS/TTA; no AP admission threshold or bootstrap
rules.interpretation: source120 is small, no independent test inference or patient/seed stability claims; allow no-new-module decision
